instruction: A candid outdoor medium full shot captures a couple dancing joyfully on a grassy hilltop with distant mountains under an overcast sky. The woman in the yellow cardigan and blue jeans (R1) is positioned on the left, leaning back and spinning with a happy smile. The man in the red striped shirt and brown pants (R2) stands on the right, facing forward and smiling warmly. They hold hands tightly, spinning together in a dynamic motion. The lighting is soft, natural daylight, creating a cool, scenic color palette across the landscape.
